package contract_types

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "reflect"
    "testing"
)

// A unit variant (ess/22, beyond10x/ess#418) is the tag alone: both variants round-trip, and a
// unit variant written with a content member, a payload variant written without one, and an
// undeclared tag are refused.
func TestUnitVariantWire(t *testing.T) {
    for _, text := range []string{`{"kind":"Open"}`, `{"kind":"Complete","value":{"outcome":"shipped"}}`} {
        var decoded DemoWorkStatus
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &decoded); err != nil { t.Fatal(text, err) }
        raw, err := json.Marshal(decoded)
        if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        var want, got any
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &want); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(want, got) { t.Fatalf("%s round-trips as %s", text, raw) }
        event := `{"status":` + text + `}`
        var reported DemoWorkStatusReported
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(event), &reported); err != nil { t.Fatal(event, err) }
    }
    for _, text := range []string{`{"kind":"Open","value":{"outcome":"shipped"}}`, `{"kind":"Open","value":null}`, `{"kind":"Complete"}`, `{"kind":"Closed"}`} {
        var decoded DemoWorkStatus
        if json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &decoded) == nil { t.Fatalf("accepted %s", text) }
    }
}
